todo.title: Todo

permissions.title: Permission configuration
permissions.description: Set a default for all projects, or choose a project to configure it separately.
permissions.globalDefaultDescription: Applies to projects without their own choice. Full access is the default.
permissions.projectChoiceDescription: This choice only applies to the selected project.
permissions.noProjectsDescription: Open a project to configure its access mode.
permissions.rulesDescription: Open in your system's default app. Creates an empty file if none exists.
permissions.rulesDesktopOnly: Open rule files in the Ling desktop app.
permissions.precedence: Project choices take priority over the global default. Running turns use the new mode after they finish.
permissions.fullAccessNote: Full access skips this permission system, including configured deny rules. Your rule files stay unchanged.
permissions.approvalNote: Approval follows your existing global and project settings, and asks only when those settings require confirmation.

questions.hint: Answer pending questions above the composer.

backgroundTasks.empty: No background tasks in this session.

schedules.title: Scheduled tasks
schedules.tagline: Set a time. Come back to the result.
schedules.composePrompt: Help me create a scheduled task. First confirm what to do and when to run it, then show me the configuration for approval before saving.
schedules.emptyDescription: Describe a recurring task in a conversation, or choose the time and instructions yourself.

briefing.title: Daily project briefing
briefing.prompt: Every weekday, summarize this project's progress and outstanding work. Help me choose a time and create a scheduled task.

weeklyReview.title: Weekly review
weeklyReview.prompt: Help me schedule a weekly review of this project, covering changes and open questions. Confirm the day and time with me.

schedules.footnote: Tasks run while Ling is open. Missed runs follow each task's settings.
schedules.noRuns: No runs yet. The result will appear here after this task runs.
schedules.deleteConfirm: Delete this task and its run history? Conversations are kept.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.timeZoneHint: Enter a valid time zone, for example Asia/Shanghai.

archivedSession.readOnly: This conversation is read-only: its project folder was deleted.

builtinFeatures.title: Built-in Ling features
builtinFeatures.description: Choose the features available to the agent. Changes reload open conversations; a busy conversation applies them when its turn finishes.
builtinFeatures.todo: Load the bundled Todo extension and check unfinished work. A Todo package installed through Pi keeps its own settings.
builtinFeatures.permissions: Enable access-mode controls. Turning this off uses full access; saved project choices and rules are retained.
builtinFeatures.questions: Let the agent ask questions and collect your answers in the conversation.
builtinFeatures.background-tasks: Run shell commands alongside a conversation and retain their output.
builtinFeatures.schedules: Run tasks at scheduled times. Turning this off suspends future triggers; missed occurrences are skipped when re-enabled.
builtinFeatures.disabled: This feature is off. History and controls for finishing existing work remain available.
builtinFeatures.permissionsDisabled: The permission system is off. New turns use full access after resources reload. Saved access choices and rules apply again when enabled.
builtinFeatures.disabledError: This feature is off. Enable it in Settings → Plugins before starting new work.
builtinFeatures.voice: Off by default. Dictate into the draft with {{shortcut}} while the composer is focused.
builtinFeatures.mcp: Connect external tools with global and project configuration. Off by default.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.description: Record on this device and transcribe locally with Pi Voice. Text is added to your draft for review.
voice.downloadNotice: Download {{size}} MB from Hugging Face. The model is stored on the computer running Ling.
voice.noSpeech: No speech was detected. Try recording again.
voice.draftFull: Your draft is full. The transcript is kept below; shorten the draft and insert it again.
voice.recording: Recording. Stop to transcribe, or press Escape to discard.
voice.menuHint: Right-click or press and hold for voice options
voice.openProject: Open a project to configure voice input.
voice.shortcutHint: In the composer, {{shortcut}} starts or stops recording, Esc cancels, and {{settingsShortcut}} opens settings.
voice.modelLanguageHint: Models supporting your interface language appear first. Language support varies by model.
voice.operationFailed: Voice input could not complete. Retry or check voice settings.

captureError.unsupported: Use the desktop app or a secure browser connection to record audio.
captureError.permission: Allow microphone access for Ling or your browser, then try again.
captureError.missing: Connect a microphone, then try again.
captureError.busy: The microphone is unavailable. Check its connection and other apps using it, then try again.
captureError.disconnected: The microphone disconnected. Reconnect it and record again.
captureError.limit: The recording exceeded its size limit. Make a shorter recording.
captureError.recording: Recording failed. Check your microphone and try again.
captureError.decode: The recording could not be decoded. Record it again.

mcp.title: MCP services
mcp.description: Connect tools and data to Pi. Manage shared services and project overrides in the same configuration files used by Pi.
mcp.builtinHint: Off by default. A Pi-installed adapter takes precedence and keeps its own enable state.
mcp.globalHint: Shared by all projects. Project settings can override a service with the same name.
mcp.projectHint: Only affects this project. Global services are inherited; a local entry can override them.
mcp.removeConfirm: Remove “{{name}}” from this file? A lower-priority configuration may become active.
mcp.precedenceHint: Pi configuration overrides shared configuration. Saved changes apply to affected projects; busy sessions apply them when safe.
mcp.invalidFile: This configuration could not be read. Repair it before saving.
mcp.effectiveHint: Includes inherited services and project overrides. Inherit enable state removes only the project’s on/off override; other options are kept.
mcp.noEffective: No MCP services are configured for this project.
mcp.nameExists: A service with this name already exists in this file. Edit it instead.
mcp.name: Service name
mcp.argsHint: One argument per line. Run the executable directly; shell quoting is not needed.
mcp.advancedHint: Preserves upstream options such as env, headers, auth, directTools and lifecycle. Use bearerTokenEnv for tokens; avoid committing credentials to project files.
mcp.newHint: Services connect on demand by default. Saving reloads Pi resources; advanced options can change connection behavior.
mcp.openSession: Open a conversation in this project to connect and see live status.
mcp.noLiveStatus: Live status is unavailable. Enable the built-in adapter and reload this conversation. Native status supports adapter 2.37.0.
mcp.configChanged: This file changed outside this editor. Read the latest configuration, review it, then save again. Your draft is retained.
mcp.draftRetained: Latest configuration loaded; your draft is unchanged. Saving again replaces this service with your draft and preserves other services.
mcp.serviceRemoved: This service was removed. Saving will create it again.
mcp.nameHint: Use a unique name without spaces, such as my-service, so connection actions remain available.
mcp.invalidName: Enter a name of up to 200 characters without spaces or control characters.
mcp.commandRequired: Enter an executable, such as npx, uvx or an absolute path.
mcp.invalidUrl: Enter an HTTP(S) URL or an environment reference such as ${MCP_URL}.
mcp.invalidJson: Check the JSON syntax and option values.
mcp.singleServiceJson: Paste one service object here, without the outer mcpServers wrapper. The service name belongs in the name field.
mcp.approvalHint: Controls MCP tool confirmations. Ling access rules still apply. Inherit keeps the upstream or lower-priority setting.
mcp.approvalCustomHint: Set approveTools to the tool names or patterns to confirm in Advanced JSON. An empty list requests no additional MCP approval.
mcp.runtimeOff: The built-in adapter is off. Enable it above to connect services from Ling. Configuration editing remains available.
mcp.waitForIdle: Connection actions will be available after the conversation or configuration update finishes.
mcp.commandNameHint: This name contains spaces. Edit its name in the configuration file to use connection actions.
mcp.multilineArgs: Empty arguments and arguments containing line breaks require Advanced JSON to preserve their exact values.
